{"id":1809416892,"question_id":3768,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"9 months","timestamp":1761223190,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"3 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1809416892/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Check If Digits Are Equal in String After Operations I","memory":"8.6 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool hasSameDigits(string s) {\n        string ans = \"\";\n\n        int i = 0;\n        while(s.size()>2 && i < s.size()-1)\n        {\n            ans += (s[i] + s[i+1]) % 10;\n            i++;\n\n            if(i == s.size()-1)\n            {\n                s = ans;\n                i = 0;\n                ans = \"\";\n            }\n        }\n        return s.size() == 2 && (s[0] == s[1]);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"check-if-digits-are-equal-in-string-after-operations-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":951}
